statement.en: forall x y z, z in x <-> z in y -> z in x -> z in x and z in y
statement.ja: forall x y z, z in x <-> z in y -> z in x -> z in x and z in y

script:
theorem conj_example : forall x y z, z in x <-> z in y -> z in x -> z in x and z in y.
intros x y z H H0.
split.
exact H0.
cases H H1 H2.
exact H2.
qed.

explanation.en: First, try to proceed with the proof as in the previous lesson.
explanation.ja: まずは前回と同様に証明を進めてみましょう．

progress.en:
To prove a goal of the form P and Q, use

split.

to prove both P and Q.
progress.ja:
P and Q の形のゴールを示すには，

split.

を使って P と Q 両方を示します．

progress.en: The goal has been split into two. The first goal can be proved using the methods we have already learned.
progress.ja: ゴールが2つに分かれました．一つ目のゴールは今までの方法で証明できます．

progress.en:
There is a hypothesis P <-> Q. This is shorthand for P -> Q and Q -> P. A hypothesis of the form H : _ <-> _ or H : _ and _ can be decomposed with

cases H HL HR.

If you omit HL and HR, names are assigned automatically.
progress.ja:
仮定の P <-> Q がありますね．これは P -> Q and Q -> P の略記です．仮定 H : _ <-> _ や H : _ and _ は，

cases H HL HR.

で分解できます．HL や HR を省略すると自動で名前が付きます．

progress.en: From here, we can complete the proof using the methods we have already learned.
progress.ja: この先はこれまでの方法で証明できます．
